capabilities: convert pinyin on the current line to Chinese characters
convert natural-language math descriptions into LaTeX
include note context in the conversion prompt for better results
configure API base URL and model
disambiguation: Not a system input method editor; it converts already-typed pinyin text in the current line on command, using an AI model.
extras: README is written in Chinese. The recommended Groq model is free for personal use, so no paid service is required. The README warns that including note context may produce unwanted extra output, and includes a troubleshooting section for API connection, invalid responses and parsing errors.
motivation: The author, a full-pinyin IME user, found frequent IME word selection disrupted writing flow and wanted pinyin-to-Chinese conversion without leaving English input mode.
problem: Switching between Chinese and English input modes, and picking candidate words in the IME, interrupts fluent writing, especially in vim mode and when writing math.

relations.evidence: 推荐使用 Groq 平台的免费开源 llama-3.3-70b-versatile

summary: Uses an AI language model to convert pinyin typed in English input mode into Chinese characters and LaTeX math formulas in the current line.
